title: Replace a motor vehicle tradesperson certificate
summary: You can apply for a replacement motor vehicle tradesperson certificate if your original certificate has been lost, damaged, or destroyed.
intro:
If your motor vehicle tradesperson certificate has been lost, damaged, or destroyed, you can apply for a replacement in person at a Service NSW Centre, or by email.

To look up your certificate number and details, visit Verify NSW.

faqs.q: How can I check my certificate number and details?
faqs.a: You can look up your certificate number and details by visiting Verify NSW.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a replacement certificate?
faqs.a: You can apply for a replacement in person at a Service NSW Centre, or by email.

faqs.q: Where can I submit my completed form?
faqs.a: You can submit the completed form at a Service NSW Centre.
